proof_attempt_summary: Discovery built a coherent population-level pair-audit model, exact sharp transport bounds, a rational forest recurrence, an explicit [2/55, 2/5] example, and a near-uniform-overlap Independent Set reduction; the math review reported no substantive finding. The field-level claim collapsed because the finite random-set energy, exactly-k graph objective, and broad tractability/hardness split are antecedent specializations, leaving only an incremental causal synthesis. The final derivation still has disclosed claim-status mismatches for thm:graph-reduction, thm:forest-certificate, and thm:graph-hardness, to-prove statuses for lem:threshold-section and prop:path-certificate, and a stale rendered \\iffD token; no Lean formalization was started.
tldr: For randomized compound treatment with separate binary outcome and singleton/pair audit margins, the core gives a sharp causal-effect interval and reduces uniform-rollout thresholds to cardinality-constrained graph energy. An exact \(O(m^3)\) rational forest recurrence supplies certificates. For every fixed \(p\ge1\), general-graph upper-threshold and complemented strict-sign decisions remain NP-complete and coNP-complete even when every feasible rollout-to-study ratio differs from one by at most \(m^{-p}\); the encoding has an inverse-polynomial no-instance section-cost gap.
gap: Random-set lower expectations already give the pair-row minimum, exactly-\(k\) sparsest induced edges and broad forest tractability are known, separate-margin sharp bounds are established, and multiple-version stochastic policies are identified under richer observed laws. The inspected full theorem texts do not combine these into the specified three-margin pair-flow causal realization and exact normalized forest/general-graph threshold classification.
fill: Establish sharp full-data realization, the uniform-rollout cardinality identity, a reconstructible \(O(m^3)\) rational forest certificate, and a bounded-ratio probability-normalized Independent Set encoding proving NP/coNP causal threshold classification. These linked results, rather than any ingredient alone, are the proposed field-level contribution.
